marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Factors of design 3 : visual, tactile and aesthetic

This program introduces two inspirational new products and explores the visual, tactile and aesthetic factors that inform their design. '321 Water' is an attractive personal water purifier aimed at health-conscious women. 'Tear Lab' is a non-threatening medical tool for measuring salt levels in tears. The Australian designers of these products show us prototypes and development drawings and talk frankly about their design process. We see how their designs consider line, colour, shape and form, as well as structural elements, and touch and feel.
